title: Flaky login test in CI
description: test_login_returns_token intermittently fails in CI. Suspected race: the test asserts on the token before the async user-cache write completes. Good first issue for a new joinee.

title: Add refund endpoint
description: Expose POST /refunds. Must be idempotent using an Idempotency-Key header. See architecture.md for the payment_intent lifecycle.

title: Document environment variables
description: The .env.example has grown but the README does not explain each variable. Add a table describing DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, QUEUE_URL.

title: Migrate money columns to integer minor units
description: Historical rows stored amounts as floats. Migrated all amount columns to integer cents to avoid rounding errors.

title: Make checkout idempotent
description: A retried checkout (double-click or network retry) can create two orders. Require an Idempotency-Key header and return the same order for the same key. See orders.md and code/checkout.py.

title: Prevent overselling on the last unit
description: Two concurrent checkouts can both buy the last item. Reserve stock before payment and raise OutOfStock rather than letting available stock go negative. See code/inventory.py.

title: Add faceted search filters
description: Add category, price-range and in-stock facets to product search on OpenSearch. Local dev falls back to substring match in code/catalog.py search_products.

title: Coupon rounding drift
description: A percentage coupon computed with floats dropped a paisa on some totals. Fixed by integer math: subtotal_cents * percent // 100. Related to PAY-063.

title: Inventory alert for top sellers hitting zero stock
description: BOOK-RAG-01 was out of stock 9 days in Q2, ~6-8 lakh lost GMV (see sales/sales_q2_2026.md). Alert #team-fulfilment when a top-50 SKU drops to zero.
